title: Walk among the Very Large Array antennas
description: Cross the open New Mexico plain to the Very Large Array and follow the visitor center’s self-guided route toward one of its giant radio antennas. Exhibits explain how the dishes work together to study a universe our eyes cannot see. The remote landscape gives the machines room to impress you before you learn what they hear.
teaser: Stand beneath a radio telescope in the New Mexico desert.
goodToKnow: Before you go, confirm visitor hours, tour availability, altitude and walking requirements.
whyItMightDelightYou: The contrast between vast silence and instruments listening to space is hard to forget.
